scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@ai-video-editor/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:worker && npm run start --workspace=@ai-video-editor/worker
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@ai-video-editor/worker
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@ai-video-editor/web
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build --workspace=@ai-video-editor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.db:create: npm run build:packages && node packages/db/dist/cli.js create
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && node packages/db/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:verify: npm run build:packages && node packages/db/dist/cli.js verify
scripts.test:db: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/db/dist/integration.test.js packages/db/dist/projects.test.js
